newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Investec jumps at start on results' leap.
newsitem.headline: Investec jumps at start on results' leap.

text.p: Shares in Investec Bank Ltd, an acquisitive South African banking and financial services firm, rose at the start of trade on Thursday after posting year earnings well ahead of analysts' expectations, dealers said.
By 0738 GMT, Investec shares were up 100 cents to 151 rand, beating the previous 150 rand record high set last week.
"It was a good set of results. The outlook for the stock is looking good," a dealer on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) said, adding that the share was seen higher still on the day.

Investec on Wednesday reported headline diluted earnings per share up 36.3 percent at 572.1 cents, well ahead of a Reuters poll of analysts who expected a rise to between 550.0 and 558.3 cents a share.
Dealers said the JSE had in recent weeks been very sensitive to company results, many of which had been below forecast.
"When they have been bad, stocks have taken a knock. But with good results like these (from Investec), it looks like they will take the stock up," a dealer said.
Investec said it received a boost from a first-time contribution from Israel General Bank, which was bought last June, as well as robust growth in advances.
It said it expected its strong growth in earnings and dividends to continue in the future, while furthering international expansion.
